name: Powers-of-Ten Zoom
summary: One continuous infinite-canvas dive from 38 dashboards of dots down to the single wrong data point Pulse found, and back out as every dot turns teal.
look: A dark infinite canvas of glowing dot clusters with a zoom pill, breadcrumb and minimap as the only chrome. Nested outlines mark depth; the deepest level is one coral data point with its value set huge in mono.

motion.name: Log-space zoom
motion.how: interpolate log(scale), 4-6 s per dive, sine.inOut, land on a downbeat

motion.name: Level-of-detail cross-fade
motion.how: dots to labels to chart to number at scale thresholds over 0.2 s

motion.name: Pull-back reveal
motion.how: expo.out zoom-out 1.6 s with a teal ripple staggered by distance

story: Hook: at 3% zoom 38 dashboards are clouds of dots and one flickers coral: '38 dashboards. Where is the problem?' Reveal: every dot flies onto the pulse line and the Acme Pulse lockup appears. Proof: a log-space dive through dashboards › checkout › conversion to the 09:42 point, 2.80% (was 3.42%), with a card for checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231 and the human choosing Roll back. CTA: pull back to 100% as a teal ripple turns every dot teal; 'Every metric. Every minute.' and Start free.
adapt: Map your own hierarchy onto the dive (workspace, project, item, field) and make the deepest level the one value your product catches.

fit.risk: text and SVG blur at extreme scale; swap nested layers at thresholds instead of scaling one DOM
